title: CPR to Golden!
description:
Different generations, different songs. Same life-saving beat! 💓

Move over, Bee Gees. “Golden” by Huntr/x from K-Pop Demon Hunters is having its moment and is a great song for CPR! 💫

The life-saving rhythm recommended for chest compressions is about 100 - 120 bpm. October is Sudden Cardiac Arrest Awareness Month. Learn more: sandiego.gov/sdprojectheartbeat. 

#cprogramming #golden #kpopdemonhunters #huntrix
